prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1009; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end collision sustained while the patient was turning left, with neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism. The reported injury corresponds well with the kind and force of the impact described. Over the course of care, the patient completed 28 visits including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical spine. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the history obtained. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward functional limits. Two similar billing entries for the same date of service are currently under review and are being verified against the clinic's records. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
